bagPolicy.summary: The Texas Athletics clear-bag rule allows clear plastic bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon resealable bags and clutches smaller than 4.5 × 6.5 inches. The football guide does not establish whether an individual concert has a different bag rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The official 2026 football parking page lists garages and lots including Brazos, Manor and LBJ, but it does not publish concert parking assignments or rates. Check the concert event page.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For football, Texas Athletics designates the south curb of Dean Keeton Street between Robert Dedman Drive and Red River Street for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Concert routing may differ.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The stadium’s football guide says concession and merchandise purchases are cashless and that cash-to-card kiosks are in the Hall of Fame and at Gate 7. Outside food and drink are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For football, accessible guest entry is designated at Gates 7, 14, 16 and 27; Fan Services golf carts can transport guests with mobility, hearing or vision impairments toward the gates. Concert arrangements may differ.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The football guide prohibits re-entry at football games but does not state the policy for concerts at this stadium.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The football guide identifies mobile ticket support at ShopBack Gate and LLH Gate but does not publish a concert will-call procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For football, gates open two hours before kickoff and guests must use the gate on their mobile ticket. Concert opening times and assigned gates are event-specific.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
